body:
[A10] READY TAKEOVER / ASSIGNMENT

Executor A157; independent cleared-context internal reviewer R223; external reviewer R224. Manager A10. The issue's settled acceptance is unchanged: expose the existing 16-bit default-VID parameter through protocol_processor_top, preserve default 2 and runtime Domain behavior, document the interface, and prove the real top-level binding with a mutation-sensitive test.

Live main is 424c688fa2205b934a7689a58f2aa766420f2326. Open PR26 changes only syn/yosys/run.sh; this lane does not edit that file or take over that branch. Branch 95-expose-default-sr-vid is created through gh issue develop from main. Move to In progress before the first edit. No open design decision remains.

Validation: focused pp_top/SRP/default/adoption/link tests; scripts/run_suites.sh; scripts/lint_hdl.sh; make check; scripts/gen_matrix.py --check; the current Yosys/hosted gates; two independent positives with all five lenses; candidate and post-merge containment. The parent pin stays unchanged until this donor work lands and the parent #400 lane validates integration. One author slot only; A156 has finished. Model roles rotate for this RTL lane: Opus author/internal review and independent Codex external review.

[A157] TAKEN

Branch: `95-expose-default-sr-vid`, cut from main `424c688fa2205b934a7689a58f2aa766420f2326`. One author slot; reviewers R223 (internal) and R224 (external) as assigned by [A10].

Authoritative references: this issue and its settled acceptance; parent kebag-logic/milan-fpga#400 and its 2026-09-22 pre-implementation decision (vid row); Milan v1.2 4.2.7.2.1; `docs/README.md` §2 (P-IDs live only in 01 §7 F01.5, parameter values only in F01.5); `docs/architecture/01_overview.md` §7 F01.5; `docs/architecture/10_srp_engine.md` §6.1 F10.2 and §11; `docs/guides/integrator.md` §2 and §8; `hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv` (KL_srp_top instance); `hdl/srp/KL_srp_top.sv` `DOM_DEF_VID_P`; `hdl/srp/KL_srp_domain.sv` (reset, LINK_UP declaration and LINK_DOWN revert all read `DEF_VID_P`).

Interpreted scope: add one public `protocol_processor_top` parameter, `logic [15:0] SRP_DOM_DEF_VID_P = 16'd2` (P-ID `P-SRP-DOM-DEF-VID`), bound explicitly to `KL_srp_top.DOM_DEF_VID_P`. Register it in F01.5 and document it in the integrator guide and the SRP engine page (F10.2 cites the P-ID instead of repeating the value, per the single-source rule). `hdl/srp/` is not touched: no width, default, timer, priority, adoption, MVRP, frame-format or microprogram change. The shipping default stays 2; a non-2 value exists only as a verification fixture proving propagation.

Test plan: a focused Domain-default phase in `tb/pp_top` drives the real top on a fresh model. The suite Makefile builds it twice: once overriding nothing (expects the top's own default 2) and once with a verification-only fixture override. Each build grades the reset value, the LINK_UP Domain declaration on the MSRP wire byte-exact (the full 16-bit SRclassVID), the class-D port, snapshot word 10 and GET_DOMAIN, the GET_TX_STATE stream VLAN a controller sees, adoption of a bridge Domain (Lv of the default then New of the adopted), LINK_DOWN revert and LINK_UP re-declaration. Mutation controls in a scratch copy: binding removed, bound to a literal 2, truncated, and the top default changed.

Validation plan (compile jobs capped at 8): `tb/pp_top` (both builds), `tb/srp_top`, `tb/srp_encoder` (child-level Domain adoption and link revert), `tb/timer_map` (real-top elaboration sweep), `./scripts/lint_hdl.sh`, `make check`, `python3 scripts/gen_matrix.py --check`, and a read-only run of `./syn/yosys/run.sh`. PR26 and its `syn/yosys/run.sh` are not edited. The full sweep, hosted gates, reviews and publication stay with the manager.

Blockers: none.

[A157] MATERIAL DECISIONS (implementation head `ea93023fbdd31cbf718da0d8f1aab4d750bfd21a`, local and unpublished)

1. **Name.** The public parameter is `SRP_DOM_DEF_VID_P` (`logic [15:0]`, default `16'd2`), registered as `P-SRP-DOM-DEF-VID` in 01 §7 F01.5. The `SRP_` prefix scopes it among the top's engines and keeps it apart from gPTP's `gptp_domain_i`. The rest is the child's own `DOM_DEF_VID_P`, so the binding reads one to one: `.DOM_DEF_VID_P (SRP_DOM_DEF_VID_P)`. The P-ID follows F01.5's convention of mirroring the RTL name.
2. **No engine change.** `hdl/srp/` is untouched. The child keeps its 16-bit width and its own default of 2. The only RTL change is the declaration and one explicit binding in `hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv`.
3. **No elaboration guard.** The top does not refuse non-2 values: the verification fixture needs one, and elaboration behaviour stays unchanged. Refusing other shipping defaults belongs to the parent builder, per the #400 decision. The donor documents "keep it at 2 in a product build" in F01.5, the integrator guide and the parameter banner.
4. **Documentation.** New F01.5 row. F10.2 now cites `P-SRP-DOM-DEF-VID` instead of repeating the value, because `docs/README.md` §2 allows parameter values only in F01.5. Additions in 10 §11 and integrator guide §2 (the parameter row) and §8 (link-down restores the defaults). Deliberately unchanged: `docs/guides/operator.md` ("VLAN 2" is true for every product build), and diagram 21's shape box, which is a summary rather than a parameter list.
5. **Test shape.** `tb/pp_top` builds twice. The first build overrides nothing, so it grades the top's own default, and runs every section plus the new section DV. The second build overrides the top with the verification-only fixture `0x5A3C` and runs DV alone. DV runs on a fresh model in both builds: reset value, LINK_UP declaration byte-exact, GET_DOMAIN, snapshot word 10, GET_TX_STATE VLAN, bridge Domain adoption (Lv of the default, New of the adopted), LINK_DOWN revert and LINK_UP re-declaration.
6. **Fixture value.** Every plausible fault on `0x5A3C` gives a distinct value: missing or literal (2), 8- or 12-bit truncation (0x003C, 0x0A3C), byte swap (0x3C5A), or routing to the priority (reads 4). Its low 12 bits (0xA3C) are a legal VID; only the 16-bit MSRP field shows the top nibble. The C++ expectation is compiled from the same Makefile variable and is never read back from the DUT.
7. **Tally.** Each binary prints a per-build line. The Makefile sums both into the one canonical `N checks: N PASS, N FAIL` line that `run_suites.sh` reads. This is the `tb/dyn_state` precedent; the tally file lives under git-ignored `obj_dir/`, and a missing build tally fails the suite.
8. **Mutation evidence** (scratch copies of the tree). Binding removed: fixture 13/20 FAIL, default 0 FAIL. Bound to literal 2: 13/20. Truncated to 12 bits: 4/20, the wire checks only. Bound to `DOM_DEF_PRIO_P`: default 16/1391, fixture 13/20. Top default changed to 3: default 18/1391, fixture 0. Wrap override removed: 13/20. Child default changed to 7 with the binding intact: both builds green.
